narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The other strip can be any length, because the thread still makes four sides.
<bookmark mark='try'/>Swap in a shorter strip and watch the corners of the frame.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The corners stop being right angles, so four sides alone do not make a rectangle.
